input: A train speed is 60 km/h, how much distance will it cover in 30 mins? Explain your calculation.
expected_output: The train will cover 30km(kilometer) in 30 minutes, assuming it maintains a constant speed of 60 km/h.Calculation: Distance = Speed × Time = 60 × (30/60) = 30 km.
context: The train will cover 30 kilometres(km) in 30 minutes, assuming it maintains a constant speed of 60 km/h.Use the Distance = Speed × Time formula.
